user_stories.title: Define benchmark task models and 12 diverse tasks
acceptance_criteria: Create BenchmarkTask Pydantic model with id, name, category, goal, expected_answer, tools, scoring_method, difficulty fields
Define 12 benchmark tasks across 4 categories: math (4 tasks), code (4 tasks), research (2 tasks), planning (2 tasks)
Create get_benchmark_tasks() function that returns all 12 tasks
Create get_task_by_id(), get_tasks_by_category(), get_tasks_by_difficulty() helper functions
All tasks validate correctly with Pydantic
Exact match tasks have expected_answer field populated
Tool names match built-in tools (calculator, code_execute, web_search_mock, file_read)
Unit tests in tests/evaluation/test_tasks.py pass
Type checking with mypy passes
user_stories.notes: Foundational work with no dependencies on other evaluation code

user_stories.title: Implement SingleAgentBaseline
acceptance_criteria: Create SingleAgentBaseline class that uses AgentFactory to create single agent
Solve() method executes agent directly without delegation
Returns tuple of (answer, cost_record)
Uses ToolRegistry to get tool objects from tool names
Builds AgentTuple with instruction, context, tools, model
Unit tests mock AgentFactory.create_and_execute()
Tests verify answer and cost_record are returned correctly
Integration tests verify no delegation occurs
user_stories.notes: Depends on AgentFactory and existing infrastructure

user_stories.title: Implement StaticRolesBaseline
acceptance_criteria: Create StaticRolesBaseline class with fixed sub-agents: math_agent, code_agent, research_agent, planning_agent
Each agent has predefined tools and context
_select_agent_type() uses LLM with temperature=0 to select appropriate agent type
Solve() method executes selected agent and returns (answer, cost_record)
Handles invalid agent type selections gracefully (defaults to 'math')
Unit tests mock OpenAI client for agent selection
Tests verify all 4 agents are created with correct tools
Tests verify agent selection logic works with various goals
user_stories.notes: Depends on AgentFactory, more complex than SingleAgentBaseline

user_stories.title: Implement exact match scoring
acceptance_criteria: Create score_exact_match() function with normalization options
Normalizes case (lowercase by default, optional case_sensitive parameter)
Normalizes whitespace (collapse by default, optional ignore_whitespace parameter)
Supports substring matching (if expected is contained in actual)
Returns 1.0 for match, 0.0 for no match
Handles None values gracefully (returns 0.0)
Create score_exact_match_with_tolerance() for numeric comparison with tolerance parameter
Unit tests cover: exact match, case sensitivity, whitespace, substring, None values, numeric tolerance
All tests pass
user_stories.notes: Independent, can be developed in parallel with baseline implementations

user_stories.title: Implement LLM-as-judge scoring
acceptance_criteria: Create score_llm_judge() async function using OpenAI client
Uses temperature=0 for consistent scoring
Prompt includes goal, answer, and evaluation criteria (accuracy, completeness, clarity)
Parses float from LLM response, clamps to [0.0, 1.0] range
Returns 0.5 on parse failure (default score)
Create score_llm_judge_with_details() that returns (score, reasoning) tuple
Unit tests mock OpenAI client responses
Tests verify: score parsing, clamping to range, parse failure handling
Integration tests with real LLM confirm reasonable scores
user_stories.notes: Depends on OpenAI client, temperature=0 for consistency

user_stories.title: Create EvaluationResult model and BenchmarkRunner
acceptance_criteria: Create EvaluationResult Pydantic model with all required fields: task_id, task_name, task_category, task_difficulty, system, answer, score, cost_usd, latency_seconds, total_tokens, delegation_count, model_breakdown, error, timestamp
Create BenchmarkRunner class that initializes with tasks, model, tool_registry, lambda_param, num_trials, timeouts
Implement _run_aorchestra() that executes Orchestrator and extracts metrics from OrchestratorState.get_cost_summary()
Implement _run_single_agent() that executes SingleAgentBaseline
Implement _run_static_roles() that executes StaticRolesBaseline
Implement _run_benchmark() that executes single task for single system with timeout handling
Implement run_all() that executes all tasks for all three systems (aorchestra, single_agent, static_roles)
Apply scoring based on task.scoring_method (exact_match or llm_judge)
Handle timeouts with asyncio.wait_for(), record error in EvaluationResult
Handle exceptions gracefully, record error in EvaluationResult
Implement get_summary() that calculates per-system statistics: accuracy, avg_cost_usd, avg_latency_seconds, avg_tokens, total_delegations
Unit tests mock baseline executions and orchestrator
Tests verify: timeout handling, error handling, metrics extraction, scoring application
Integration tests verify full workflow with mocked LLMs
user_stories.notes: Core evaluation harness, depends on tasks, baselines, scoring

user_stories.title: Implement JSON report generation
acceptance_criteria: Create generate_json_report() function that takes results dict and optional metadata
JSON structure includes: metadata (timestamp, num_tasks, systems), results (per-system list of EvaluationResult dumps), summary (calculated statistics)
Merge provided metadata with default metadata
Use EvaluationResult.model_dump() for serialization
Calculate summary statistics via _calculate_summary() helper
Summary includes: by_system (accuracy, avg_cost, avg_latency, avg_tokens, total_delegations), by_category (avg_score, avg_cost), by_difficulty (avg_score, avg_cost)
JSON is valid and machine-readable for Denario pipeline
Unit tests verify JSON structure and content
Tests verify summary calculations are correct

user_stories.title: Implement markdown report generation
acceptance_criteria: Create generate_markdown_report() function that takes results dict and optional metadata
Report includes: title section, metadata section (if provided), Overall Summary table, Summary by Category table, Summary by Difficulty table, Per-Task Results breakdown
Overall Summary table shows: System, Tasks, Accuracy, Avg Cost ($USD), Avg Latency (s), Avg Tokens, Delegations
Per-Task breakdown shows comparison of all three systems for each task
Format percentages as XX.XX% (e.g., 75.00%)
Format costs with $ and 6 decimal places (e.g., $0.001234)
Format latencies with 2 decimal places (e.g., 1.23s)
Markdown renders correctly with proper table formatting
Unit tests verify markdown structure and formatting
Manual verification confirms report is readable

user_stories.title: Create CLI evaluation script
acceptance_criteria: Create scripts/run_evaluation.py as entry point
Load configuration from environment (ZAI_API_KEY, ZAI_API_BASE, ZAI_MODEL, LAMBDA, COST_RATES)
Use Config.from_env() from aorchestra.config
Initialize ModelConfig from environment
Create ToolRegistry with built-in tools
Initialize BenchmarkRunner with all 12 tasks, model, tool_registry, lambda_param
Run full evaluation with runner.run_all()
Generate JSON report to output/evaluation_results.json
Generate markdown report to output/evaluation_report.md
Create output directory if it doesn't exist
Print progress to console (starting benchmarks, per-task completion, final summary)
Handle keyboard interrupts gracefully
Exit with status code 0 on success, 1 on failure
Document usage in --help message
Script executes end-to-end without errors
user_stories.notes: Depends on all previous user stories

user_stories.title: Run full end-to-end evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Execute python scripts/run_evaluation.py with real LLM

No errors or timeouts occur
JSON report is generated and valid (can be parsed)
Markdown report is generated and renders correctly
Metrics are reasonable: accuracy between 0.0 and 1.0, costs positive, latencies positive
AOrchestra shows strengths vs baselines (e.g., higher accuracy, reasonable cost)
Review reports and confirm they demonstrate AOrchestra value
Document expected runtime and cost for full evaluation
Create sample output files to include in repository documentation

user_stories.title: Add comprehensive test coverage
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for all components: tasks, baselines, scoring, runner, reports
Test edge cases: None values, empty strings, invalid inputs, timeouts, errors
Use mock objects for LLM responses (following conftest.py pattern)
Integration tests for full evaluation workflow with mocked LLMs
